import pandas as pd

# Source file path
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/training_0.csv"

# Load source data with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history:
# group_by = [Source1_35_0.Source Zipcode]
# aggregations = [sum(Source1_35_0.Counts)]
# So we group by 'Source Zipcode' and sum 'Counts'

# Perform the group by and aggregation
df_target = df_source0.groupby("Source Zipcode", as_index=False)["Counts"].sum()

# Ensure the target schema types: 'Source Zipcode' and 'Counts' as integers
df_target["Source Zipcode"] = df_target["Source Zipcode"].astype(int)
df_target["Counts"] = df_target["Counts"].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
